legal_units.title: Penalty for failure to furnish statement or information or document by an eligible investment fund.
legal_units.text: If any eligible investment fund required to furnish a statement or any information or document under paragraph 4 of Schedule I, fails to do so within the time prescribed under the said paragraph, the income-tax authority prescribed under the said paragraph may direct that such fund shall pay, by way of penalty, a sum of Rs. 500000.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XXI PENALTIES Section 456 Penalty for failure to furnish statement or information or document by an eligible investment fund. If any eligible investment fund required to furnish a statement or any information or document under paragraph 4 of Schedule I, fails to do so within the time prescribed under the said paragraph, the income-tax authority prescribed under the said paragraph may direct that such fund shall pay, by way of penalty, a sum of Rs. 500000.
